name: Qianqian (Quinn) Wang
title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science; Kempner Institute Investigator
department: Computer Science, John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences; Kempner Institute
fitReason: Current vision-and-robotics research connects geometric representation learning to object-centric manipulation. SelfEvo (April 2026, co-advised) adapts pretrained reconstruction models using unlabeled video, including offline DROID wrist-camera evaluation; it is not a new robot-control experiment.

physicalEvidence.summary: Robot See Robot Do (CoRL 2024) uses an actual ABB YuMi with soft grippers and a ZED 2 camera. Pretrained visual features support reconstruction and motion planning from an object scan and one demonstration video. Nine objects with ten orientations each produced 54 successful complete executions out of 90. This is prior Berkeley collaboration, with current Harvard robot access unverified.

unknowns: Important duration mismatch: the current SEAS Fellow category expressly includes outside graduate students with a bachelor’s degree but requires a minimum three-month appointment. An eight-week exception or alternative appointment has not been verified. Treat this as a conditional lead requiring duration flexibility or an approved alternative, not established eight-week feasibility.
The inspected physical manipulation study is from 2024. The fresh 2026 paper tests perception on existing videos; it does not establish current Harvard hardware or autonomous manipulation.
RSRD uses reconstruction and motion planning, not a learned end-to-end action policy. Its stages have different denominators; 60 percent is the complete-task success rate.

The existing Harvard institutional supplement documents appointment-dependent funding and sponsorship. Self-funded status in one appointment handbook does not establish the actual graduate-visitor category.

Summer 2027 acceptance, mentor capacity, exact dates, funding, visitor appointment, and applicable university/immigration approvals remain unconfirmed. Self-funding alone does not establish eligibility.
